item.title: Effective Strategies for Handling E-commerce Shipping
item.description: The article discusses the management of e-commerce shipping, focusing on key aspects such as the definition of delivery, the importance of notifications in the delivery process, shipping labels, shipping rates and methods, calculating shipping costs, packaging, customs declaration and forms, and e-commerce shipping best practices.

item.title: How to start a business in 10 steps
item.description: This article outlines ten essential steps to initiate a successful online business, emphasizing the importance of a clear plan, an exceptional product, and a robust marketing strategy. From defining the project idea to receiving the first orders, the guide aims to assist aspiring entrepreneurs in achieving success in their online ventures.
